items.question: Within how many months from the end of their financial year must entities under the UAE Economic Substance Regulations submit their annual notification form and Economic Substance Report?
items.gold: Within 12 months from the end of their financial year.
items.fact: ESR notification and report due 12 months after financial year end

items.question: Under the UAE Economic Substance Regulations, must an entity that has not earned income from a Relevant Activity file an Economic Substance Report?
items.gold: No, it is not required to file an Economic Substance Report if it has not earned income from a Relevant Activity.
items.fact: No ESR report needed without income from Relevant Activity
